name: Causal overclaim (Kanıtsız nedensellik)
definition: Co-variation or time order alone is presented as cause.
boundary: Needs an explicit causal statement; chronology alone is not enough.

source_variants.name: Causal Overclaim (Nedensellik aşırı iddiası)
source_variants.definition: Presenting a relationship as a definite cause-and-effect link and closing off other explanations.
source_variants.coverage_reason: No named mechanism, required state or observation model is implemented in the original Mesa sample.
